description: Send Quarterline a requirement (Grease trap pumping for Austin restaurant groups, on one 90-day calendar). Your board is recorded as a request and given a reference number, shown on screen when you send it. A person reviews the locations, trap sizes, frequencies, last pump-outs, current haulers and service windows you gave, and sources service from liquid waste haulers holding a City of Austin permit. The reply comes by email to the address you leave, with a proposed calendar for all your locations, how one invoice and per-location manifests would work, and a firm price for you to accept or decline. Nothing is scheduled, ordered or committed until you agree terms. Contact details are deleted after 180 days. It is answered with a receipt: keep its id and token to read its status (request_status), to add details later (continuation) and to act on an offer made in reply. A requirement is not an order and costs nothing.

continuation.description: The receipt id and token of an earlier request, to add to it instead of opening a new one

need.description: The requirement in the buyer's own words

specifications.description: Fields from the request_schema describe_business returns
